## RunEnv.digest property

the opaque text a personal key shows as in results, row steps and gate ids. Default: the  SHA-256 of the entity and the key id, which hides the key from a reader but not from someone  who can guess it; give a keyed HMAC, the same on every instance, for keys that can be guessed  (an email address)

**Signature:**
